proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ _ q x y
  refine ⟨QuadraticMap.associated_eq_self_apply K q x, ?_⟩
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (QuadraticMap.two_nsmul_associated K q) x y
  simpa [two_mul, QuadraticMap.polar, two_nsmul] using h
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [Invertible (2 : K)] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (q : QuadraticForm K V) (x y : V), QuadraticMap.associated q x x = q x ∧ 2 * QuadraticMap.associated q x y = q (x + y) - q x - q y
